text:
deploy-bot: Started rollout of service/api v2.8.0 -> canary 5% in us-west-2 at 14:02 UTC
joan: seeing a small p95 blip on the SLA dashboard, looks correlated with canary traffic increase
kevin: pulled up the SLO panel — p95 spiked from 210ms -> 420ms, error budget burn 0.6% in last 5m
anya: logs show a cluster of 500s from nodegroup-gamma, pattern: `kvcache miss -> longer latency -> request timeout`
matt: interesting, we pushed the kvcache GC tweak in this release (kv-cache v1.1). Could be GC pause + cold prefix builds
sre-bot: Alert: canary-slo: p95 > 350ms for 3m, 5xx rate 0.9% (threshold 0.5%) :rotating_light:
joan: can we reduce canary to 1% and hold while we triage? prefer not to rollback yet if we can mitigate quickly
deploy-bot: Adjusting traffic: canary=1% now. Will confirm once routed.
kevin: good move. I'll start collecting KV cache heatmaps and tail latencies for affected nodes
anya: quick check: rolling restart of nodegroup-gamma reduced 5xx locally in staging. But in prod the GC cycles are aligned across pods
matt: propose pinning the previous kvcache image (kv-cache:v1.0.9) on canary hosts and re-evaluating. We can roll that out to canary only.
joan: agree. If pin reduces errors, we can continue gradual rollout. If not, rollback full canary.
sre-bot: Suggestion: enable short-debounce on the SLO watcher to avoid immediate rollbacks, we want 3 consecutive 1m windows to trigger an auto-rollback
kevin: running quick patch: apply image override for selector `app=service-api,canary=true` -> `kv-cache:v1.0.9`
anya: command run:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/service-api service-api=redwood/service-api:v2.8.0 --record --overwrite
kubectl -n prod patch deployment service-api -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kvcache-override":"v1.0.9"}}}}}'
```
kevin: patch applied, reconciling pods (rolling 2/5 so far)
joan: watching SLO dashboard and 5xx stream. If p95 drops under 300ms and 5xx < 0.5% for 4m we keep canary at 1% and resume to 10%
matt: also adding note to release notes: "temporary pin of kv-cache to v1.0.9 for canary due to latency regression; investigating GC tuning"
deploy-bot: Canary traffic reduced and override in place. Next autoscaler event at ~14:40 UTC
sre-bot: Observability check: enable KV cache metrics debug for canary pods for next 20m.
kevin: enabling. collecting heap/GC traces to upload to S3 -> s3://redwood-debug/canary/1758912345/
anya: after the image pin, 5xx rate down to 0.3% and p95 260ms at 14:18 UTC :thumbsup:
joan: great. Hold at 1% for another 15m and then ramp to 20% if stable. No rollback needed for now.
sre-bot: Logged incident draft: "canary kvcache GC correlation causing transient p95/5xx spike" assigned to matt/kevin, priority P2
matt: I'll open a follow-up: perf regression ticket + GC tuning experiment, label `release-2.8.0`
joan: thanks everyone. Add a short blurb to the release notes and mark the change window as extended by +20m in the calendar.
kevin: uploading traces now, will paste link once available
kevin: s3 upload complete: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-debug/canary/1758912345/gctrace.tar.gz
joan: closing loop: no rollback, partial pin applied, monitor for 1h then decide on full rollout. :white_check_mark:
